summary: Coeur Mining filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a private exchange offer and consent solicitation related to $400M aggregate principal of 6.875% Senior Notes due 2032 issued by New Gold Inc. Coeur issued $385.774M of its own 6.875% Senior Notes due 2032 in exchange for Existing Notes tendered, with no cash proceeds received. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, ranking equally with existing unsecured senior debt. The exchange was conducted under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S. This is a debt refinancing transaction, not a special situation; no shareholder vote, acquisition, or strategic change is involved. Watch for typical post-exchange trading of the new notes.
